title: Raw transport besides QR
description: Engineering consequence of HCERT Specification, 4.1 Raw. HCERT Specification, 4.1 Raw: “the HCERT container and its payloads may be transferred as-is, utilising any underlying, 8 bit safe, reliable data transport”.

statements.label: Raw transport besides QR
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL be able to return the signed COSE_Sign1 bytes without the barcode encodings, and the verifier SHALL accept COSE_Sign1 bytes directly, for 8-bit-safe transports (NFC, Bluetooth, app-to-app).
